subject: How to Edit Data Frame using Filter and Mutate

messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: How to Edit Data Frame using Filter and Mutate
parts:
I have a variable (additiveInd) that I wish to set to 1 when some conditions are met.  How can I do this using dplyr?  Here is what I've got:

chain(
  dataMat,
  filter(Boat=='Boat One', Date2>dateValue),
  mutate(additiveInd=1)
)

This sets additiveInd to 1 for the correct observations but I'm not sure how to integrate this back to the data frame?  I would normally do this:

dataMat[dataMat$Boat=='Boat One' &  dataMat$Date2>dateValue,'additiveInd']=1

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: How to Edit Data Frame using Filter and Mutate
parts:
Hi Glen,

Why not do

dataMat %.% mutate(additiveInd = Boat == 'Boat One' & Date2 > dateValue)

?

Hadley
